Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: enable pilots across Orion Finance analytics teams with Redwood hosted inference while meeting your security & procurement requirements.
- Key decision criteria you called out: SOC 2 evidence, data residency controls, SSO (SAML/Okta) support, and predictable latency/SLA for pilot workloads.
- Mutual action plan:
  1) Security intake & questionnaire (I attached the questionnaire we typically use).
  2) Stakeholder mapping: economic buyer, procurement owner, security reviewer (we'll need their availability).
  3) Kickoff meeting with security + infra to confirm systems in scope and timeline.

Can you please:
- Confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (name + email).
- Confirm who will own the security questionnaire (we find one SME paired with procurement speeds this up).
- Proposed availability for a 30–45m security kickoff next week (I proposed Tue/Wed morning PT below).

I’ve cc'd Sean (solutions eng) who will help scope the infrastructure questions. I’m also looping in Marissa (security) once you confirm who will own the questionnaire so we can schedule the kickoff.

Attachment: Orion_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (questionnaire stub)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

Hi Priya / Liam —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on stakeholders. I’ve attached our standard intake (Orion_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) and a short intake form below to help us scope the kickoff: 

1) Systems in scope (select all that apply / provide FQDNs where relevant):
   - Production analytics cluster (e.g., redshift, databricks)
   - Internal data lake / S3 buckets (include bucket prefixes)
   - Customer-facing apps (web/mobile) — do these send data to Redwood?
   - Any PII/PHI datasets that may be part of prompts or embeddings
   - SSO provider (Okta / SAML / OIDC) — admin contact and metadata file if available

2) Network diagram / egress policies — please attach a simple diagram or list of IP ranges that will be allowed to call Redwood endpoints.

3) Pilot timeline & procurement gating — what are your target dates for PO / contract signature and for pilot start?

If you can paste answers inline below or attach the network diagram, that will help us tailor the kickoff agenda (we typically reserve 20–30m for technical scope and 15–20m for procurement/Q&A).

Attachment: Orion_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we have the confirmed kickoff date.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / team —

Thanks — happy to take this on. Quick answers inline: 

1) Systems in scope:
- Production analytics cluster: Databricks workspace (prod.analytics.orionfinance.com)
- Internal data lake: S3 buckets (s3://orion-prod-data; s3://orion-embeddings) — embedding pipeline writes to s3://orion-embeddings
- Customer-facing apps: Not in scope for pilot (we will not send customer PII to Redwood during the pilot)
- PII/PHI: No PHI; limited PII (hashed user ids) — we will provide redaction rules if needed
- SSO: Okta — I can share metadata and connect our Okta admin (cc Marcus for procurement access)

2) Network diagram: attaching a simple diagram (orion_network_diagram_v1.png) and we will provide egress IP ranges next week.

3) Timeline & procurement: target PO signature by Aug 1, pilot start Aug 8. Marcus will coordinate contract review — Marcus, are there any standard SLAs/clauses you need from Redwood ahead of the kickoff?
